answer: Every applicant faces the same trial, Lens tester walnut mark mounted on the polishing lathe, and every verdict reads the same way: each walnut is a year of spectacle logs in the optician's ledger. A beacon can be painted, a shale can be borrowed, but a haven must be lived, and the farm has lived nothing. An honest proof costs 216 POA; the farm pays the same per proof but needs 550 of them, which totals 118800 POA. Two independent readers reaching the same answer: that is the whole check.
